summary: Nicola Mining Inc., a Vancouver-based silver explorer listed on NASDAQ (NICM), TSX.V (NIM) and FSE (HLIA), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 18, 2026 news release announcing commencement of its first-ever 2026 exploration drill program at the MB Zone of the Treasure Mountain permitted silver mine near Hope, British Columbia. The program comprises four diamond drill holes totaling roughly 800 m, run by Western Exploration Diamond Drilling Ltd., with core submitted to AGAT Laboratories and assays expected by year-end. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is an ordinary operational exploration update, not a special situation.
